title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named campus gathering spaces identified in Swarthmore’s current student handbook as locations for events without alcohol.

cards.title: Sharples Community Commons
cards.subtitle: Dining and Community Commons
cards.notes: Plan a sober gathering with your group, then use the student-space request process rather than assuming a room is open.
cards.short_summary: A current handbook-listed option for events without alcohol.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025–2026 Student Handbook lists Sharples Community Commons among spaces where events without alcohol may be held.
cards.access_notes: Student social-space requests are reviewed by the Office of Student Engagement; confirm availability and approval before planning.
